argument: The continuous shell must read as one produced material body before it reads as five selectable ports. Facet scale, void around the shell, asymmetrical curvature, and seam hierarchy must carry the composition without interface chrome.

With labels, readout, controls, hint, and prose hidden, the blind view must leave v045's stratigraphic mass, v046's folded ledger, and v047's absence arch. It should read as a surface whose production law can be changed, not a generic mesh demo.

The visitor must press at the lit source and travel to a specific exit. Pointer, touch, keyboard, and the route control must offer equivalent meaningful paths; no hover-only action may carry the work.
An uncompleted route, repeated source, wrong origin, and wrong exit must leave every surface vertex exact. Only a valid source-to-exit route may re-produce geometry.
The exit is not a label: after a committed route, the source port must visibly migrate and the engine must refuse pressure from any other origin. This is the work's memory-bearing encounter.
Pressure must alter production variables—curvature, depth, torsion, facet pressure, and seam lift—rather than add an overlay line or recolour a fixed shell.
Four routes must compound in one shell. Lift must reconstruct the exact preceding surface and release must return to the deterministic quiet state.
The shell, source port, route controls, and keyboard path must remain visible and reachable at 320px and 390px without horizontal overflow or a hover-only dependency.
Generated WEBGL mesh facets, pressure seams, deterministic state, and capability reporting are the medium. No screenshot, imported model, external font, or brush library may carry the work.

p5.brush is translated from programmable material production and vector-field redirection into a pressure route that rewrites a continuous shell and hands its exit forward. Brush presets, watercolor, hatching, grain, source palette, source composition, source code, examples, and API surface are refused.
v048 changes representation, composition, encounter, temporal memory, and medium: a continuous surface and stateful two-port travel replace the mass, cadence ledger, and social absence arch.
Delete v048 if routes are cosmetic, wrong origins or exits commit, the shell does not globally re-produce, later routes reset, exact lifting fails, or the blind image reads as a generic 3D surface.
